claims.claim: The application persists workflow and settlement state in PostgreSQL.
evidence: PostgreSQL 16 local migrations
GET /api/health returned db=connected
Managed PostgreSQL 18.6 direct strict-CA query verified with 63 public tables on 2026-08-16
claims.limitations: The platform-managed preview DATABASE_URL remains non-PostgreSQL, so deployed persistence has not been verified.

claims.claim: Signed settlement evidence is idempotent, atomic, auditable, and reversible.
evidence: 176 Vitest tests
9 Playwright PostgreSQL settlement scenarios including hermetic provider-simulator coverage
local migration chain through 0025
production fail-closed dispute lock and workflow transition guard tests
claims.limitations: Evidence covers an isolated PostgreSQL database and development keys; it does not prove a provider or bank transferred funds.

claims.claim: The platform can initiate and settle real funds through a regulated provider.
evidence: Fail-closed internal service token
live payment mode rejected by the Go sidecar
sandbox execution requires explicit mode
hermetic test-only provider simulator rejects production and non-disabled execution modes
claims.limitations: Live initiation is intentionally unsupported. A contracted provider sandbox, mTLS interoperability certificate, settlement report feed, and regulated-rail acceptance evidence are still required before any provider execution can be enabled.

claims.claim: EMR/FHIR extraction provides real data to disputes.
evidence: Synthetic extraction removed; endpoint returns 503 without a real connector
claims.limitations: No authenticated FHIR provider connector or sandbox evidence is configured.

claims.claim: Daily settlement proof and exception review execute durably and alert operators.
evidence: PostgreSQL-backed 8-scenario settlement E2E suite
Heartbeat task-UID configuration persistence
claims.limitations: The deployed PostgreSQL binding and production Heartbeat job have not been created or observed.

claims.claim: The repository separates development compose from a fail-closed production overlay.
evidence: Development compose is explicitly labeled and simulator-profiled
production overlay requires mandatory secrets and explicit endpoints
production configuration validator rejects local databases and unsupported live initiation
claims.limitations: The production overlay has not been deployed against hardened provider, identity, search, etcd, Kafka, and TigerBeetle services; production interoperability evidence remains required.

claims.claim: EMR credentials are encrypted at rest before persistence.
evidence: AES-256-GCM versioned envelope
tamper rejection unit test
production key validation
claims.limitations: A managed KMS/HSM and key-rotation service are not configured in the isolated environment.

claims.claim: TigerBeetle read connectivity uses a loopback-only client behind a CA- and hostname-verified mTLS tunnel.
evidence: Uploaded CA and client certificate verified
client private key stored as runtime-only secret
strict stunnel TLS tunnel to tigerbeetle.newfire.app
read-only lookupAccounts assurance probe passed
claims.limitations: Only non-mutating client connectivity was exercised. TigerBeetle is not authorized to initiate provider transfers, and external production interoperability still requires deployment evidence.

claims.claim: Database backup and restore are automated and integrity-checked.
evidence: Encrypted local PostgreSQL recovery drill with 63-table and critical-table count verification
claims.limitations: A production backup destination, retention policy, and deployed restore drill have not been observed.
